title: Build an UNRELEASED 1.5.1 off the release line and hand the beta user a delta bundle to verify the slow-install fixes

reason: Retargeted from an unreleased 1.5.1 to a 1.5.0 -> master delta (Fabio, 2026-09-11).

summary: MPI-722 landed so master reads 1.6.0 and the build needs no --version. Fabio confirmed the reporter is on 1.5.0, so a delta is the right bundle, and the output goes to D:/CubricStudio/Vision/Builds. Building from a DETACHED WORKTREE at master HEAD: build-portable copies the WORKING TREE, and this one carries ~31 uncommitted files from three live peer sessions.

Delta built and checked: CubricVision-windows-x64-update-v1.6.0.zip, 15.5 MB, fromVersion 1.5.0 -> toVersion 1.6.0, 563 files, 22 deletes, none under a PRESERVE prefix. Built from a detached worktree at df2400bf because build-portable copies the WORKING TREE and this one held ~31 uncommitted files from three peer sessions. The three fixes verified by reading bodies out of the zip. Handover note written beside the artifact. Remaining check is external: the reporter runs it and his app.log comes back.
